name: Sacred Helm
upgradeable: Epic Crafting to Epic Sacred Helm

effects.name: Negative Energy Absorption
effects.tooltip: Negative Energy Absorption : This effect absorbs negative energy and energy drain effects.

effects.name: Deathblock
effects.tooltip: Deathblock : The wearer of this item is immune to all death spells and magical death effects.

effects.name: Eternal Faith
effects.tooltip: Eternal Faith : An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Eternal Faith increase the owner's effective level for the turning check by +2, his maximum Hit Dice turned by +2, and his total Hit Dice turned by +4.

effects.name: Divine Blessing
effects.tooltip: Divine Blessing : 2 Pieces Equipped: +2% Artifact bonus to Light, Alignment, and Positive Spellcrit Chance +10 Artifact bonus to Light, Alignment, and Positive Spellpower

flavor_text: Though used primarily by drow ascetics, this helm will protect any healer from death magic and the undead.
tips: Completes to a set item with the Ring Sacred Band
